facts.fact: The Guardian reports that the second National Broadband Plan (2020-2025), with a 70 per cent broadband reach target, expires in two days, and NCC head Aminu Maida says engagement with the ministry on a third plan has begun.

NGA.note: Document gives unserved-community counts but no programme or rural-urban use split.
Document states nothing on state budget money.
Document says a draft spectrum roadmap was published but not that outsiders were asked.
Document states only that NCC is examining direct-to-device and low-orbit satellite use; no licence or sale.
